description: This file contains functions and classes for client-side post-processing of chart data in Apache Superset, including pivot table transformations, table formatting, and data application logic for different visualization types.

methods.name: get_column_key
methods.description: Generates a sortable key for columns, especially for multi-index labels with metrics.

methods.name: pivot_df
methods.description: Performs pivot table transformations, including totals, subtotals, and metric calculations.

methods.name: list_unique_values
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of unique values in a pandas Series.

methods.name: pivot_table_v2
methods.description: Creates a pivot table using specified parameters and the pivot_df function.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Formats a DataFrame into a table, applying number formatting if specified.

methods.name: apply_client_processing
methods.description: Main function to process chart data results, applying the appropriate post-processing based on visualization type.
